method: E = signed qty*(inclusion fair - fill); M = signed qty*(final fair - inclusion fair). G = gasUsed*min(tip,maxFee)*final WETH. Residual retained; no causal counterfactual.
limitation: Full weak-world spot accounting only. spotWallet reconstructs spot flows, gas, and the logged two-step SP entry debit; it excludes other specialist credits/wrapping/launch flows. Other incz regimes are triage metadata, not complete wallet or recovery audits.
